name: Daily Cash Report
query:
SELECT 
    name AS "Payment Entry ID",
    posting_date AS "Posting Date",
    party_type AS "Party Type",
    party AS "Party",
    paid_amount AS "Amount Received",
    mode_of_payment AS "Mode of Payment",
    payment_type AS "Payment Type",
    paid_to AS "Paid To"
FROM 
    `tabPayment Entry`
WHERE 
    payment_type = 'Receive'
    AND paid_to = 'Cash - SC'
    AND posting_date = CURDATE()
ORDER BY 
    posting_date DESC;
